# Multi Agent Orchestration

## When to use
Use when the task requires coordinate 11 named research, feasibility, QA and execution subagents while enforcing independent review.

## Procedure
Input: stage and candidate IDs. Route discovery in parallel; separate research from independent QA; send blockers to bounded rework; escalate after three corrections. Output delegation matrix, conflicts with proof, gate state, and next user approval. Never treat subagent consensus alone as evidence.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
